notes.title: Another Gamescom, another demo update 🐷💀🖤
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]
We're thrilled to announce that Spindle will be playable again at Gamescom this year! 
[b]From August 20 to 24, visit Kim & Tom in Hall 10.2 at the Deck13 Spotlight Indie Arena Booth[/b] 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40899870/8a7d1d7ae161d3255354c1fedac7e73823124ac9.png[/img]
[h3]Some familiar sights, but so much more to explore[/h3]
To celebrate this occasion, [b]we're adding a bunch of new content to previous versions of the demo.[/b] This update really highlights how far we've come in terms of the level of detail and the attention we've put into every little interaction in our world.

[b]Experience the beginning of the game, including the never-before-seen intro,[/b] and explore how the first area of Spindle changes after defeating the dungeon boss. This gives you a much better idea of what the final game will feel like, with lots of fun details to discover 🐣

[h3]Let us know what you think[/h3]
If you're also attending Gamescom, be sure to stop by and chat! Otherwise, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/3Qr4B3TqN5]Discord server[/url] and tell us your thoughts on the update there! 

The finish line draws near, so please enjoy the demo and [b]stay tuned for more information soon[/b] (especially regarding the exact release date 👀)! 
And as always, thank you for your ongoing support, we were so happy to see how excited people were about last week's trailer 💌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1386750/Spindle/

notes.title: We're getting closer: Our Release Window Trailer ⏰
notes.content: [h2]Hi everyone![/h2][p]Great news: [b]we're almost at the finish line,[/b] and we can now give you a better hint on when you can expect to start adventuring with Death and Pig 💀🖤🐷[/p][p][/p][p]And now, drumroll please... [/p][h3]Spindle will release in ***ber 2025 🎉[/h3][p]We know, we know - it's not quite a specific date yet. However, it won't be too long until we can tell you more![/p][p]In the meantime, check out our new [b][url="https://youtu.be/vCPE6ZAC6aM?feature=shared"]Release Window Trailer[/url][/b] to discover some [b]new areas, enemies, and obstacles[/b] that you'll need to overcome in [i]Spindle[/i]. We've come a long way since we began development, and we're extremely proud of our progress.[/p][p][/p][p]Also: [b]stay tuned![/b] Another update is coming next week, and it may be related to [b]Gamescom and our Demo[/b]... 👀  [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/vCPE6ZAC6aM?feature=shared"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40899870/f0d158c1eca4935139ee1e2cd631084460ca45b6.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1386750/Spindle/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Spindle looks quite sweet, and one I haven't heard anything about for a while after its successful crowdfunding campaign back in 2021. But there's a new trailer to show it off.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/11/death-has-a-cute-little-pig-companion-in-action-adventure-spindle-check-out-the-new-trailer

notes.title: Spindle's New Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone[/b], we’re excited to share something special with you: 

[h3]Our brand-new Gameplay Trailer![/h3]

This trailer lets you see some of the exciting [b]new content[/b] we’ve been cooking up, along with a glimpse of the [b]improvements we’ve made throughout development![/b] 
It gives you a sneak peek into the thrilling journey of our dynamic duo, as they explore vibrant biomes on foot, by boat, and even scale towering heights. Get a taste of the adventure ahead as you control both Death and the Pig, shifting from [i]quiet[/i], peaceful moments to [i]intense[/i], action-packed fights 💥

Give it a watch and [b]let us know what you think![/b]
We’re excited to hear your thoughts as we keep working hard to bring the full game to you 🐷💀🖤

[previewyoutube=L3DFO8V5gH4;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1386750/Spindle/

notes.title: Tick-tock, it's Gamescom time ⏰
notes.content:
Another year, another Gamescom experience!
[b]Spindle will be present again at the Indie Arena Booth 2024. You can find us in [u]Hall 10.2[/u][/b] 🎉

We don't have a new demo to show you this time, but you should definitely [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561197984675714]check out our pre-recorded Steam stream![/url][/b] Our colleague played through some new and exciting areas that you can look forward to in the final game 👀

The core dev team won't be at our booth this year as we're hard at work polishing all the different areas. However, please feel free to stop by and say hello to our publishing friends at Deck13 Spotlight, who will be there all week. 

We're super excited to see the game taking shape and getting closer to our final goal. 
[b]Thank you so much for your continued support[/b], and for those of you who have yet to play our demo: [i]Please do, we put a lot of heart into it[/i] 💜

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1386750/Spindle/

notes.title: Spindle @ Gamescom 2023 & Demo Update
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce: [b]Spindle is part of Gamescom 2023![/b]

To show you what we've been working on, we're bringing you an [b]updated demo[/b] of our game. If you're attending the convention, you can find us at the [b]Indie Arena Booth in Hall 10.2[/b]. We're looking forward to meeting you, so stop by and say hello! 
Of course, the new demo will not only be available at Gamescom, but also here on Steam. Head over to the Steam page to check it out!

notes.title: Spindle Developer Stream & Demo Update #2
notes.content:
Just so that you know, due to our english skills the video is pre-recorded. But nevertheless you will learn a lot about Spindle, how it all started and what the motivations are.

Also, a new update for the demo is available!

[b]Spindle Changelog v1.2.0[/b]
- New underground areas
- Pig can now go down into holes
- New lumberjack side Quest
- Nicer coin reward at skeleton
- bug fixes (probably)

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
Finally, the first update for the Demo is out now! And we even added a few minor features and fixed a few bugs!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] After 30 seconds you can pet the pig!
[*] Improved the basement of the mill
[*] Coins now have 1, 4 and 10-Steps
[*] Fixed multiple transition bugs
[*] Improved the analog stick controls
[*]Title Screen has a small Kickstarter Info
[/list]

notes.title: In Spindle you become Death and figure out why no one is dying along with your pet Pig
notes.content:
Spindle certainly has an interesting premise that's worth keeping an eye on. You take on the role of Death, as you try to find out why no one seems to able to die, with your pet Pig companion.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/07/in-spindle-you-become-death-and-figure-out-why-no-one-is-dying-along-with-your-pet-pig
